newsitem.title: UK: British Gas demerger vote set for February.
newsitem.headline: British Gas demerger vote set for February.

text.p: British Gas Plc said on Thursday it will seek shareholder approval for its proposed demerger on Ferbuary 12, 1997.
British Gas will float off a new company, called Centrica, which will house its gas sales and trading, services and retail businesses together with its Morecombe Bay gas fields off northwest England.

The remaining British Gas will be renamed BG Plc and will comprise the Transco gas transportation and storage business along with BG's oil and gas exploration and production, international downstream, research and property activities.
Shareholders will receive one Centrica share for every British Gas share held on the record date for the demerger.
British Gas plans to publish the demerger document on January 10, 1997, with shares in Centrica expected to start trading on February 17.
